scope: Safe generated-preamble source matching for metadata-only submission annotation updates

value.uploaded_source_sha256: SHA-256 of actual fetched uploaded bytes
value.normalized_source_sha256: SHA-256 after the explicitly bounded v2 transformation

schema.binding: The proof uploaded SHA must equal the record actual uploaded_source_sha256; validation rejects malformed or mismatched proof entries. No current generated SHA is substituted for the actual uploaded SHA.

algorithm.prefix: Only line comments, blank lines, fixed SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS/NDEBUG defines and the exact generated three-line GCC optimize guard are traversed. All nonmetadata prefix bytes remain.
algorithm.removed: Only // Verify, // Submission and the first // Library label. The first Library boundary ends scanning immediately; all following library preamble comments, raw strings, block comments, includes, main and I/O bytes are opaque.
algorithm.line_endings: CRLF is mapped to LF only when no raw-string token occurs anywhere. No other whitespace/blank-line/trailing-newline normalization is performed. LF raw strings are allowed when body bytes agree.
conservative_refusals: Line continuations, including whitespace after backslash; trigraph and digraph preprocessing spellings; token pasting; lone CR/NUL.
Known line/source observability (__LINE__, source_location, line/file builtins, __FILE__ family, stacktrace), #line and #embed.
Unknown prefix macros/directives, raw/block state before the library label, duplicate Verify labels, missing generated boundaries.
algorithm.purpose: A narrow source transformation with conservative guards, not general C++ token, semantic or machine-code equivalence.

legacy_compatibility.v1: Existing v1 records and legacy unsafe/raw/block/continuation tests remain supported under their prior rules.
legacy_compatibility.v2_precedence: A record with the additive v2 proof field never falls back to the wider old v1 normalization.
legacy_compatibility.importer: New generated-source imports use v2 first; a generated body mismatch or safety refusal cannot be rescued by v1. The previous generated-body trailing-whitespace acceptance test was intentionally tightened to require rejection. Exact bytes still match. Nongenerated old/manual fixtures retain their old restricted comparison behavior.
legacy_compatibility.handoff: Expected normalized screenshot sources use the same versioned matching helper. Expected-only evidence still yields source confirmation, never online AC.

adversarial_cases: Per-byte mutations across the body; ordinary comment, whitespace, blank-line and terminal-newline changes.
Fake metadata in raw strings, block comments, library preamble comments, later Library labels and appended body comments.
Spoofed prelude macros/includes/raw/block state and changed compiler settings.
CRLF raw refusal, LF raw acceptance, physical line continuations and line/source introspection.
Absent/mismatched uploaded SHA, malformed proof list, legacy fallback bypass and expected-only screenshot evidence.
tests.compiler_observations: Actual GCC15.2 and Clang21 programs confirm metadata-only output equality, changed raw literal output, identical runtime output but rejected ordinary-comment changes, and a __LINE__ output change that v2 refuses.

public_source_preview.unavailable_reason: Both contain physical backslash-newline macro continuations. No normalized match is asserted for them.
public_source_preview.method: Read-only proof recomputation from actual public uploaded bytes, exact uploaded SHA checks and current generated source comparison. No judgement/status writes by this review agent.

evidence_updates: The root task separately added the 70 actual-source proofs without changing historical, nonproof or SHA fields; see the linked evidence audit. This tool review did not rewrite the journal, generated source, README/status or optimization receipts.
